scope.kind: forward H1-R2 overlay; not a historical H2/KiCad edit
scope.purpose: support exactly one removable U214 or U219 Cap in the existing protected 14-contact dock

u214.name: M5Stack Cap LoRa1262 U214
u214.policy: existing receive/GNSS behavior unchanged; existing independent EXT_TX_EVIDENCE_N rule remains the only route to a LoRa TX lease

u219.name: M5Stack Cap CC1101 + NFC U219
u219.product_state: official M5 shop product; received-lot identity and revision are still mandatory
u219.contact_8: POWER_EN host output, active high and fail low
u219.policy: CC1101 receive only; NFC poll/read only; no CC1101 TX, NFC write or NFC emulation

selection_preconditions: protected 5-V branch is off and discharged
pin 10 bilateral switch is disabled by an AON pull-up on /OE
all shared SPI chip selects are inactive
an exact signed accessory profile has been admitted
u214_sequence: select signed U214 profile while branch remains off
keep pin 10 switch disabled until protected 5 V is qualified by U214_READY
enable the pin 10 switch only as an input path from U214 BUSY to RP GPIO12
release contact 8 only through the existing qualified output boundary
u219_sequence: select signed U219 profile while branch remains off
hold contact 8 POWER_EN low and pin 10 switch disabled
enable protected 5 V and require U214_READY
enable the pin 10 switch, keep NFC_CS_N high, then assert contact 8 POWER_EN
admit only CC1101 RX and NFC poll/read commands after exact identity checks
shutdown_sequence: revoke all protocol leases and make both chip selects inactive
turn off and discharge the protected 5-V branch

requirements: RP GPIO14 is configured low before the qualified output boundary is enabled
the existing protected branch and U214_READY qualification remain dominant
loss of RUN, FAULT_KILL, profile validity or protected 5 V drives or returns the contact low
no accessory may source contact 8 into an unpowered host

protected_5v_boundary.protection: existing TPS259470 true-reverse-blocking latch-off eFuse, inrush/current limit, passive discharge and TPS3808 readiness
protected_5v_boundary.paper_fit: listed U219 load is inside the existing protected Cap-branch budget
protected_5v_boundary.contact_7_gate: current official EN pin table leaves contact 7 blank/NC while the legacy dock contract calls it 5V_IN; do not energize a received U219 until continuity, polarity and exact revision schematic prove this path
protected_5v_boundary.failure_rule: if received-unit proof does not establish protected contact-7 power, reject the U219 profile; do not invent an alternate power feed

pin_10_bidirectional_boundary.path: u214_connector.PIN_10 <-> existing connector ESD <-> SN74CBTLV1G125 A/B <-> RP GPIO12

aon_enable.switch_oe_pull: 10 kOhm to AON_SAFE_3V3; disabled when driver is open
aon_enable.command_default: 10 kOhm to SAFETY_GROUND; low/open keeps /OE high
aon_enable.command_source: existing U214_READY; the signed profile is admitted before any upstream branch request can make READY high
aon_enable.enable_condition: signed profile AND protected rail qualified AND RUN permitted
aon_enable.loss_behavior: any lost qualification releases /OE high and disconnects pin 10

pin_10_bidirectional_boundary.partial_power_down: both selected ICs provide Ioff/powered-off isolation; connector ESD remains ahead of the boundary
preserves: U214 IRQ, GNSS TX and MISO return paths
all existing Cap connector ESD channels

shared_i2c_contract.scl: official U219 contact 3 SCL -> existing u214 connector ESD -> TCA4307DGKR -> RF RP GPIO31
shared_i2c_contract.sda: official U219 contact 4 SDA <-> existing u214 connector ESD <-> TCA4307DGKR <-> RF RP GPIO30
shared_i2c_contract.isolation: existing U214_I2C_READY hot-plug/stuck-low boundary; no new GPIO, M1 contact or isolator
rules: contact 3 and contact 4 are exact current official EN-page assignments, not received-unit ambiguities
controller-side pulls remain on the host segment and the accessory-side segment is connected only after protected power is qualified
profile change requires branch-off discharge and the TCA4307 boundary disabled

shared_irq_contract.u214_role: SX1262 DIO1; active-high event semantics from the U214 profile
shared_irq_contract.u219_role: NFC_IRQ; polarity is not published in the official U219 pin table and remains received-unit HIL
shared_irq_contract.reset: accessory branch off; host input held low by the existing pull-down
shared_irq_contract.rule: never encode active-low polarity in the shared net; the admitted signed profile owns edge and level interpretation

shared_spi_contract.clock: existing U214 SCK on RP GPIO45
shared_spi_contract.mosi: existing U214 MOSI on RP GPIO46
shared_spi_contract.miso: existing U214 MISO on RP GPIO44

chip_selects.u219_nfc: contact 10 is NFC_CS_N through the bidirectional switch

rules: only the signed active profile may drive a chip select
contact 10 is never driven before the bilateral boundary is enabled
all chip selects return inactive before changing SPI mode or accessory profile
SPI timing and the published RF_SW0/RF_SW1 truth-table inconsistency remain received-unit HIL gates
the official tutorial's conflicting shared-CS prose versus separate NFC-CS example remains a received-unit trace gate

cc1101.allowed: receive, RSSI, carrier sense and packet capture only
cc1101.hardware_tx_evidence: absent for U219 CC1101; therefore TX is unconditionally forbidden

nfc.allowed: reader/poller inventory and read operations only
nfc.runtime_enable: blocked until the printed pickup, field thresholds and no-false-negative timing pass VNA/HIL

nfc_field_evidence.function: independent physical evidence that a 13.56-MHz field exists; never identity and never authorization

pickup.implementation: weakly coupled printed PCB loop with no galvanic connection to U219
pickup.placement: host RF/power PCB below the U219 NFC field structure, outside the connector and retention keep-outs
pickup.tuning: DNP C0G bank selected only after VNA and received-U219 measurements
pickup.loading_limit: insertion loss, Q change and read-range loss must remain inside HIL limits

analog_path: two BAT54S,215 packages as a four-diode balanced full-wave Schottky bridge
LMV331IDBVR with NFC_FIELD_ENV on IN-, threshold/hysteresis on IN+ and open-collector output
EV_N9_U219_NFC active low with AON pull-up

polarity.no_field: comparator released; AON pull-up makes EV_N9 high
polarity.stuck_low: conservative unexpected-evidence fault and hardware aggregate assertion
polarity.open_or_false_negative: unsafe failure; field generation remains disabled until HIL closes this mode

nfc_field_evidence.lease: NFC field-on requires the same pre-existing ANY_TX_AON_N safety observation and an explicit U219 NFC lease; evidence cannot create a lease

jlcpcb_live_surface.semantics: availability is canPresaleNumber > 0; displayed stock and catalog presence alone are not orderability

bom_delta.price_basis: saved JLC one-piece tiers for exact active MPNs checked 2026-08-28; support passives, placement fees, PCB area, freight and tax excluded
excluded: support-passive values, exact MPNs and quantities until the explicit H1 blocker closes
DNP C0G pickup-tuning bank until VNA/HIL selection
PCB loop area and placement fees
reused_existing_hardware: contact-8 output buffer, series element and connector ESD

acceptance_gates.requirement: received U219 exact revision, 14-contact pin map, POWER_EN/NFC_CS/CC1101_CS polarity and 84x24x19.7-mm maximum envelope
resolve official RF_SW1-without-exposed-pin and shared-CS prose inconsistencies against the received unit and exact revision schematic
pin10 switch truth table, reset/off high-Z, Ioff/no-back-power, U214 BUSY timing and U219 NFC_CS timing across brownout and removal
VNA proof of printed pickup-loop coupling and DNP C0G selection with bounded loading, Q/read-range loss and enclosure/battery detuning
EV_N9 asserts before the permitted field-on deadline with no-false-negative proof at minimum field across voltage, temperature, tag loading, alignment and supported reader modes
false-positive injection, adjacent RF, loop open/short, comparator stuck states, P12 fault, K2 aggregate continuity and immediate lease revocation
CC1101 command/register trace proves the receive-only firewall; NFC trace proves poll/read-only behavior
